description:
Vostok is a team passionate about space exploration, technology, and innovation. We aim to solve real-world challenges through creativity, collaboration, and science.

We’re looking for team members skilled in programming, web development, design, data analysis, or scientific research. Let’s turn ideas into discoveries!
summary:
We developed an educational website for the younger space enthusiasts (Gen Z) that you can enter and interact  with it in a fun way so the user wouldn't be bored or lose interest while exploring it .
It specializes in the equipment that have been left in space and tells it's story and why it had been left there , there is a brief summary for each equipment and a link to the actual naca site for further information.
We see the importance of our project came because of the brainrot that is affecting almost everybody these days especially the younger generation "whom are our main targeted audience", and their short attention span.
details:
It is an interactive educational website that is presinting information to the young space enthusiasts in a fun way, imagine searching the planet for the equipment that have been left there.

well guess what you don't have to because we have brought it to life, you can interact with 3d models of the moon and mars and see the exact coordinates for each one, the website also presents a tracker for the equipment that we have lost touch with it and no longer received any signals from, our tracker has the last known coordinate of it and tries to guess where it is drifting based on calculations of the algorithm of the space craft and the high likelihood of the way it may be.

we hope to educate more and more of the younger people about the space crafts that is out there and to learn as much as possible instead of losing interest quickly.

we used chatgpt to help us in writing the code and used HTML for the web pages CSS for styling and Javascript for the 3d models.

we also considered the fun part alot in our project so we could really grab the attention of the user and for them to come back so our website wouldn't be a one time experience and be forgotten about in the next two days
